articles.title: PM Narendra Modi meets Australia's Opposition Leader Angus Taylor during Melbourne visit
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi met Australia's Opposition Leader Angus Taylor during his official visit to Melbourne.

articles.title: India aspires to be one of world's top three economies driven by 'Grow more, achieve more' motto: PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi addressed the Indian diaspora in Melbourne, emphasizing India's aspiration to become one of the world's top three economies through the 'Grow More, Achieve More' initiative.

articles.title: PM Modi holds delegation-level talks with Australian PM Albanese
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi held bilateral talks with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese, discussing strengthening cooperation in defence, security, trade and investment.

articles.title: PM Modi pays tribute to Syama Prasad Mookerjee on 125th birth anniversary
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi paid tribute to Bharatiya Jana Sangh founder Dr Syama Prasad Mookerjee, recognizing his contributions as a nation-builder and his commitment to India's unity and integrity.

articles.title: Steel equivalent to 40 new Eiffel towers or five Burj Khalifas, cabling could wrap the Earth twice: PM Modi refers to materials used in Rajasthan refinery complex
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi highlighted the scale of construction materials used in India's newly inaugurated greenfield refinery-cum-petrochemical complex in Rajasthan, emphasizing India's rapid industrial progress.
